name: FREE | 🏀 RB World 5
desc:
Welcome to RB World 5, a semi-realistic basketball simulation!

- 🏀 Play with friends in Quick Play with preset & created players!
- 🏀 Create your own player!
- 🏀 Play competitively against other players in PvP!
- 🏀 Conquer the world of basketball against AI teams!
- 🏀 Customize your very own personal gym!
- 🏀 Start or join a league!

- Exploiting, cheating, or sabotaging games could get you a temporary or permanent ban.
